Confirming: Current "dev-k" commit expires on startup, dropping into "Open Loop"

Expected version: "dev-m"
Dev-K has just been uploaded. this confuses me a little...

> Dev-K has just been uploaded. this confuses me a little...

Version tag "dev-k" was already used and has expiry date 2023-09-05.
Needs fixing.
The version should be dev-m and not dev-l ;)

So what ? He can make errors too ;)
Instead of naming it M, he named it K. It happens to everyone.
![Screenshot_20230927_182714_GitHub.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/76146228-7eb6-490c-997d-10a2b6943bb5)
This isn't about typos. I already wrote above. The current, uploaded Dev version has already expired.

The last commit sets the Dev version. Then, the when it starts, the apk checks this Dev version with a file on the Net to see if it has expired.
If you don't name correctly the Dev version, then your AAPS will think that it has expired.
Change the commit and replace K with M and you'll have a working AAPS version dev-M
@elgrupo123 Please don't close, this has not been solved in dev branch yet..

@elgrupo123 Problem is clear and easy to fix.
Expecting @MilosKozak to fix this soon and close this issue.
